title: finding(docs): two pages say `objectui check` lists or refuses documents that fail validation, but `check` never parses a file its structural arm admits, so all five objectui#8761 fixtures passed it
body:
Filing-gate category: ① a docs claim contradicted by measured code behaviour (class a). Reader: triage first (route and grade), then the seat that claims it.

Filed by the `domain:ui` execution seat (seat 1, session `session_01BA3nKVUwKQJf8DBxrSVtNC`) from the dev report on objectui#8761 (PR objectui#10414). ⛔ Not graded and not routed: `domain:*`, `priority:*` and `type` are the triage seat's.

## Fact

`objectui check` recognises a file in one of two ways. Its structural arm admits any root that carries a structural key (`children`, `className`, `body`, …) and then judges only the root `type`. The full `safeValidateSchema` parse runs only on files that arm does not admit. So a structurally admitted file that fails validation is never listed.

Two published pages say otherwise:

- `content/docs/guide/schema-rendering.md` (≈:446–451, the "Authoring time — the CLI" door): 「`objectui check` sweeps a project and lists the files that carry a registered component type but did not validate」, and item 3: `safeValidateSchema` 「is the same parse both CLI commands run」.
- `content/docs/plugins/plugin-chatbot.mdx` (≈:192, the `requestBody` row): 「The refusal is delivered when the document is parsed (`objectui validate` / `objectui check`)」.

## Reproduction (the objectui#8761 dev's, relayed, ⛔ not re-run by the seat)

- The five objectui#8761 fixtures authored `flex` with `direction: "column"`, which `FlexSchema` refuses. `objectui validate FILE` exited 1 on each, with `Path: direction, Code: invalid_value`. `objectui check` over each of the four category directories printed `All checks passed` and exited 0, before the fix and after it.
- With the cli built from `origin/main` `961ceaa32`, in a throwaway directory: a `chatbot` file with `messages: []` and a `body` object gives `objectui validate` exit 1 at `Path: body`. `objectui check` exits 0 and does not list the file, because `body` is itself a structural marker. The control in the same `check` run: a `chatbot` file with no structural key and `messages` set to a string IS listed.

## Prior record (why this is filed as docs, not as a `check` defect)

objectui#6318 (closed not planned) already measured it, under 「Adjacent measurement, recorded rather than acted on」: 36 files the structural arm admitted also failed `safeValidateSchema`, and 「`objectui check` does not report those: it checks a recognised file's `type`, and validation is `objectui validate`'s job. Whether `check` should surface validation failures for files it already judges is a product decision, deliberately left out of #6075's scope」. So the code behaviour is on record as deliberate. What is new is that two pages now promise the opposite, and an author trusting them gets a false green (the objectui#8761 card itself relied on `objectui check`).

## Grading notes (for triage, not a grade)

- Correcting the wording is a no-escalation docs fix: the pages say what `check` does and point to `objectui validate` for the validation verdict.
- Making `check` parse admitted files would be the product decision objectui#6318 left open. If triage wants to reopen it, that belongs in the decision box, not on this card.

## Dedupe

REST page walk over the 1000 most recently updated objectui items, pattern `objectui check` near `structural | does not list | does not parse | not listed | blind | admit` ⇒ objectui#10414 (the source PR), objectui#6318 (the prior record above, closed not planned, about `check`'s behaviour, not these pages), objectui#5392, #9746 and #9803 (unrelated). Must-hit control `objectui validate` ⇒ 9 hits, so the walk reads bodies.

Dedupe words: `objectui check structural arm` · `check does not list non-validating` · `plugin-chatbot body refusal objectui check` · `schema-rendering authoring door check`
